title: agalinis paupercula var. neoscotica
intro: Agalinis paupercula var. neoscotica, commonly known as New Scotland agalinis, is a plant species in the Orobanchaceae family. It is a type of parasitic plant, which derives its nutrients from surrounding plant hosts. The health benefits of New Scotland agalinis include its potential use in treating various conditions, such as inflammation and oxidative stress, due to its antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, such as agalinose and ajugarin, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects.
